description: List a site's page URLs from its sitemaps and start page (deduplicated, path-filtered, with lastmod when known). Obeys robots.txt. 1 credit (normal). Use to pick pages for batch_extract.

exclude_paths.description: Path globs to drop (* one segment, ** any depth), e.g. ["/blog/**"].

ignore_query_parameters.description: Merge URLs differing only by query. Default true.

include_paths.description: Path globs to keep (* one segment, ** any depth), e.g. ["/blog/**"].

limit.description: Max links (default 200 here). Plan caps: Free 500, PAYG 1,000, paid 5,000.

search.description: Only URLs containing every word of this text (case-insensitive).

sitemap.description: 'include' (default) sitemaps + page links; 'only' sitemaps; 'skip' page links.

name: map_website
title: Map Website
